source_text: In Kenya, for instance, Jomo Kenyatta, the nation's founding president, explicitly promoted FGM in the 1950s and 1960s as a symbol of resistance against colonial suppression, linking group ceremonies to anti-colonial nationalism and embedding the practice deeper in post-independence ethnic rituals. [48]
